description: This file is a shell script used for testing the trace2 facility in Git. It defines various tests to verify the behavior of trace2 events, including start, exit, error, and bug messages, as well as configuration handling related to trace2 settings and URL redaction.

methods.name: scrub_normal
methods.description: A function to scrub variable fields from trace2 output, making test comparisons reliable by replacing timestamps, command paths, and other variable content.
